title: Korean pose catalog (sidecar of the pose files)
description: One entry per pose file (poses/<id>.json): Korean name, tags and the canonical description (정식 설명) that starts the pose prompt. Left/right in the description are the character's own.

id.description: Pose id: equals meta.id of the pose file and its file name without .json.

tags.description: Korean tags. Exactly one category tag (서기, 앉기 or 동작) plus optional extra tags.

description.description: Korean canonical description (정식 설명), one or two sentences, describing the joint data; left/right are the character's own.
